title: DragonByteZ (spicybung)
description: A reverse-engineering tool for Webfoot's Dragon Ball Z GBA games, with a desktop application and a command-line tool that read a ROM's header, analyse it, and extract its graphics and soundtrack. Supports The Legacy of Goku (Europe), The Legacy of Goku II (Europe and USA) and Buu's Fury (USA). Built from source; MIT licensed. No ROM data is included.
